Title: Software Engineer-1
Description: Rockwell Automation is a global technology leader focused on helping the world’s manufacturers be more productive, sustainable, and agile. With more than 28,000 employees who make the world better every day, we know we have something special. Behind our customers - amazing companies that help feed the world, provide life-saving medicine on a global scale, and focus on clean water and green mobility - our people are energized problem solvers that take pride in how the work we do changes the world for the better. We welcome all makers, forward thinkers, and problem solvers who are looking for a place to do their best work. And if that’s you we would love to have you join us! Job Description Essential Functions Develop, extend, and test Digital Tools services Design, build, and maintain APIs and user-facing web applications Debug production issues across services and our tech stack Identify design problems and create usable solutions Engage with product owners to determine/refine requirements and prioritize/estimate new features Work with architects to lead architecture discussions and pioneer software development best practices Write high-quality code compliant with enterprise and industry standards Analyze and improve the efficiency of various systems and services Create and execute required test scenarios/plans to ensure complete testing on all new and changed components Help to create a culture of openness, honesty, and transparency Collaborate with capability team to build an agile culture in teams Coordinate with business stakeholders to understand and document business and functional requirements related to the end-user experience Understand user needs based on business and functional requirements, user research, market analysis, customer feedback, and usability findings Build strong relationships with technical and non-technical partners across the organization. Basic Qualifications Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent relevant work experience Legal authorization to work in the US is required. We will not sponsor individuals for employment visas, now or in the future, for this job opening. Preferred Qualifications Typically requires 5+ years of software development experience Experience in systems development lifecycle Experience with Agile development methodologies Cloud-native PaaS hosting experience in Azure Experience building modern, public-facing UIs and APIs consumed by multiple teams Experience with TypeScript and a modern UI framework like React or Vue Experience with .NET, C#, JavaScript, Microsoft SQL/ Azure SQL Experience developing and deploying cloud-based solutions Experience with business complexity and project interdependencies Experience with CI/CD Scripting and Automation with PowerShell, Terraform, YAML Intellectual curiosity and the ability to question thought partners across functional areas Ability to adapt quickly to new technologies and changing business requirements Solid problem-solving skills, attention to detail, and critical thinking abilities Excellent understanding of business complexity and project interdependence Ability to partner with multiple stakeholders and influence project decisions Strong teamwork, customer service and organizational skills Strong knowledge of OOP practices and languages like C# or Java Demonstrated ability to define and maintain automated testing practices Frontend: JavaScript, Typescript, React, Redux Backend: C# .NET 5, RESTful Web API Database: Azure PaaS SQL Source Control: Azure Dev Ops/Git Hub Enterprise (Git) Orchestration/Pipelines: Azure DevOps Infrastructure: Terraform Operating System: Windows Rockwell Automation’s hybrid policy aligns that employees are expected to work at a Rockwell location at least Mondays, Tuesdays, and Thursdays unless they have a business obligation out of the office.

Title: Jr. Qualification & Digital Engineer
Description: Job Description Are you ready to approve the quality of LEGO elements & moulds today — and help build the digital tools that will shape how we do it tomorrow? As a Jr. Qualification & Digital Engineer you are able to evaluate inspection lots and conclude on rejection or approval. You take part in the approval dialogue and engage with both colleagues and relevant stakeholders. You act on quality issues when you observe them. At the same time, you are an active contributor to the digital tools agenda — working hands-on with PiWeb, automation, and API integrations alongside the Technology & Digitalization (T&D) team. Your qualification experience directly informs what the tools need to do, and your digital contribution adds value to the entire qualification process Core Responsibilities Responsible and accountable for the final evaluation of LEGO elements on all aspects (weight, measurements, function and visual) — with the mandate to reject or approve an element/mould, with support from colleagues. Be the ambassador of the right LEGO quality level. Ensure that documentation is updated and ready to pass on to the next step in the chain. Support daily element qualification operations — sparring with colleagues, supporting site colleagues on request, and contributing to a consistent and well-functioning approval flow. Actively support and contribute to the digital tools’ agenda within EMV (Element & Mould Validation) — with a specific focus on PiWeb development, reporting automation, and API integrations — working alongside the T&D team and senior digital colleagues. Participate in hands-on development, testing, and implementation of digital tools — acting as an operational bridge between daily qualification needs and the digital solutions being built. Your quality experience informs what the tools need to do. Take part in cross-departmental activities and strategic initiatives (e.g. LPP, LCI, PPS) where both a quality and a digital perspective are valuable. Do you have what it takes? If you are driven by both quality and digital innovation, and want to develop both skill sets in a world-class manufacturing environment, this role is built for you. You will grow your qualification competence through daily practice, while actively contributing to the digital agenda that is reshaping how EMV works — today and towards 2036. Experience in quality, engineering, data (Jr. level). Genuine interest in and aptitude for digital tools, data platforms, and automation. Basic understanding of quality principles and a willingness to learn element evaluation from the ground up. Curiosity and a structured, problem-solving mindset — comfortable working in an environment that combines operations and development. Willingness to travel English fluent level. Experience with digital/data tools — Power BI, PiWeb, Python, or similar. Quality background, preferably from the plastic or manufacturing industry. Knowledge of LEAN, continuous improvement, Six Sigma, or DMAIC. Understanding of manufacturing value chains and how to collaborate across functions. Experience or interest in automated workflows, scripting, or process digitalization Note This position is based at our LEGO Operaciones de Mexico manufacturing factory located in Cienega de Flores, NL This is not a remote position Note Please attach your resume in English Join the global LEGO® team The LEGO® Group recruits and develops people entirely on merit. Title: Data Analyst Product Delivery
Location: San Pedro Garza García, Nuevo León, Mexico
Description: Johnson Controls, a global leader in thermal management, mission-critical building systems, energy efficiency, and decarbonization, helps customers use energy more productively, reduce carbon emissions, and operate with the precision and resilience required in rapidly expanding industries such as data centers, healthcare, pharmaceuticals, advanced manufacturing, and higher education. For more than 140 years, Johnson Controls has delivered performance where it really matters. Backed by advanced technology, lifecycle services, and an industry-leading field organization, we elevate customer performance, turn goals into real-world results, and help move society forward. We are looking for a Data Analyst – Product Delivery. As a Data Analyst Product Delivery at Johnson Controls, you will be at the forefront of data-driven decision-making across multiple data products. Leveraging your analytical skills and expertise in data management, you will transform complex data into clear insights that drive business strategy and operational efficiency. You will partner with cross-functional teams across the globe to enhance data availability, quality, and insight generation, and you will take end-to-end ownership of analytics deliverables spanning multiple products and stakeholder groups. Key Responsibilities Data Collection and Preparation: Collect, clean, and preprocess large volumes of data from various databases and sources, ensuring data integrity and accuracy for analysis across multiple products. Multi‑Product Analytics Ownership: Lead analysis for multiple data products simultaneously, balancing priorities, defining analytical approaches, and ensuring timely delivery of insights and reporting artifacts. Data Analysis: Utilize statistical techniques and analytical tools to explore data patterns and generate actionable insights, identifying trends, anomalies, and predictive behaviors relevant to business operations. Stakeholder Collaboration: Partner with business units and product teams to understand analytical needs, translate them into well-defined requirements, and provide tailored analysis aligned to strategic goals. Business Impact Communication: Communicate the business impact of insights and changes clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders; present findings with recommendations and measurable outcomes. Continuous Improvement: Proactively seek opportunities to enhance data collection processes, improve data quality, and implement best practices in data management and analytics. Documentation: Maintain thorough documentation of analysis processes, methodologies, and findings to ensure reproducibility and knowledge sharing across the organization. Mentoring and Standards: Provide guidance to analysts on analytical best practices, reusable approaches, and documentation standards to improve overall team consistency and quality. Qualifications Bachelor’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related field; Master’s degree is a plus. 4+ years of experience in data analysis, business intelligence, or a related domain, with a track record of delivering insights that drive business outcomes. Strong proficiency in SQL for data retrieval and manipulation, along with experience in programming languages such as Python or R for data analysis. Snowflake platform experience is required. Exceptional analytical and problem-solving skills, with keen attention to detail and a strong ability to interpret complex data sets. Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to convey technical information to non-technical stakeholders clearly and persuasively. Experience supporting and managing analytics across multiple products or workstreams in parallel (requirements intake, prioritization, delivery, and stakeholder communication). Experience in statistical analysis, forecasting, and predictive modeling is desirable. What We Offer Competitive salary and a comprehensive benefits package, including health, dental, and retirement plans. Opportunities for continuous professional development, training programs, and career advancement within the company. A collaborative, innovative, and inclusive work environment that values diversity and encourages creative problem-solving. Johnson Controls does not request pregnancy or HIV testing as a condition for hiring, continued employment, or promotion, in accordance with its commitment to labor equality and non-discrimination.
